story_acceptance_criteria.note: Designated evidence layer is unit (test-plan.md: VM-001 stays unit; no endpoint accepts a payload until E4-S1). tests/unit/test_log_redaction.py passes. FINDING: the pass depends on the test itself entering redact_values(pan, aadhaar, salary_doc). RedactionFilter.filter() returns True unchanged when no values are registered, and no production module calls redact_values. Demonstrated: an identical log call leaks PAN/Aadhaar/salary without the context manager and redacts with it.

Runtime introspection under uvicorn's own dictConfig: 12 named loggers, 0 not covered by a RedactionFilter (own filter, handler filter or propagation). RedactionFilter present as an own-filter on uvicorn, uvicorn.error, uvicorn.access and truelend.access.

Same defect as QA-VM-003: 50% of log lines emitted while serving parse as JSON. Root cause located: uvicorn.access has propagate=False and its own StreamHandler with AccessFormatter, so its records never reach the app's JSONLogFormatter root handler.

Runtime probe: Money('1'|'1.005'|'1.004'|'0.1'|'12345678901.99'|'-5.555'|int|Decimal) all yield Decimal exponent -2. add/subtract/multiply all return exponent -2. Money(float) raises InvalidMoneyAmountError. 18/18 architecture tests pass.

backend/tests/architecture/test_no_float_money.py 18 passed, including test_multiply_rejects_float_scalar and a randomized principal/rate/tenure triple sweep. No float import or float arithmetic in src/types/money.py or src/api/serializers.py.

Independent 0..400 sweep: 401/401 values classified, exactly 5 distinct buckets, every bucket range contiguous, no gap and no overlap. Boundaries 0/29/30/59/60/89/90/179/180/400 all land on the D3 ladder.
classify(due_date=today, as_of=today) == CURRENT; classify(due_date=future, as_of=today) == CURRENT; classify_by_days_past_due(0) == CURRENT.

block_findings.title: QA-VM-003 / E15-S1-AC3 not met: 50% of log lines emitted while serving parse as JSON
block_findings.evidence: 3/3 trials: 2 log lines per request, 1 JSON with request_id=req-abc, 1 plain-text uvicorn access line with no request_id.
block_findings.root_cause: uvicorn.access has propagate=False and its own StreamHandler bound to AccessFormatter; configure_logging() replaces only the root handler, so uvicorn's access records never reach JSONLogFormatter.

block_findings.title: PII reaches the log sink in cleartext via the uvicorn access line; RedactionFilter is opt-in and no production code opts in
block_findings.evidence: GET /health?pan=ABCDE1234F&aadhaar=123456789012&salary=95000 produced the log line: INFO:     127.0.0.1:62890 - "GET /health?pan=ABCDE1234F&aadhaar=123456789012&salary=95000 HTTP/1.1" 200 OK. RedactionFilter.filter() short-circuits (returns True unchanged) when the _sensitive_values contextvar is empty; grep shows zero callers of redact_values in backend/src/.
block_findings.violates: E15-S1 scope_out: 'must not write applicant PAN, Aadhaar or salary-document content to any log sink'

non_blocking_findings.title: X-Request-ID is reflected and logged with no length cap, charset allow-list or truncation
non_blocking_findings.evidence: A 60,000-character X-Request-ID returned 200 with the full 60,000 chars in the x-request-id response header and the full 60,000 chars in the JSON log field. 4000/8000/16000/60000 all accepted verbatim. Raw control characters are rejected by h11 (400), and percent-encoded CRLF is not decoded, so header injection is mitigated by the HTTP parser rather than by the app. JSONLogFormatter escapes JSON-breaking payloads correctly, so there is no JSON log-injection.
non_blocking_findings.impact: log-volume amplification / disk pressure on the log sink and unbounded response-header growth from an unauthenticated request

non_blocking_findings.title: Delinquency classifier lives in the Config layer, not the Types layer the bundle declares
non_blocking_findings.evidence: classify() and classify_by_days_past_due() are exported from backend/src/config/delinquency.py; backend/src/types/delinquency.py holds only the enum. E11-S1 bundle operation 2 says the classify function belongs in backend/src/types/delinquency.py, and the story metadata says 'Layer: Types'. config/delinquency.py also re-exports DelinquencyBucket.
non_blocking_findings.impact: no layering violation (Config may depend on Types, and the import direction is correct), but the delivered structure diverges from the frozen bundle's declared structure

non_blocking_findings.title: /docs and /openapi.json are served unauthenticated
non_blocking_findings.evidence: GET /docs returns Swagger UI (loading swagger-ui from cdn.jsdelivr.net); GET /openapi.json returns 200. Currently discloses only /health and the app title/version.

non_blocking_findings.title: Two uvicorn processes wrote to one log file, producing a space-padded interleaved record
non_blocking_findings.evidence: .claude/state/uvicorn.log line 4 is 'ERROR: [Errno 10048] ... only one usage of each socket address', and line 7 carries roughly a thousand leading spaces before a valid JSON record. Operational/harness issue, not group A product code, but it means a naive line parser sees a padded line.

non_blocking_findings.title: request_id is the empty string on non-request-scoped lines
non_blocking_findings.evidence: JSONLogFormatter emits "request_id": "" when the contextvar is unset, rather than null or omitting the key.

failure_reason: QA-VM-003 / E15-S1-AC3: only 50% (1 of 2) of the log lines emitted while serving GET /health parse as JSON with request_id == 'req-abc'; the contract requires 100%. Deterministic across 3 trials. Compounded by B2-02, the same root cause leaking PII to the log sink in cleartext.
